projects.title: SHADW Terrain

projects.title: Learn Java

projects.title: Blockchain, explained
projects.line: A plain guide to how blockchains work, drawn as one stack of layers on a bedrock of hashes: keys, proof of work and stake, contracts, layer 2, bridges and risks. Mine a block, sign a transaction, break the chain.

projects.title: EngineDisplay
projects.line: A car four, a truck diesel six and a nine-cylinder aircraft radial, built as FreeCAD solids and shown at one scale on one crank angle, their pistons driven by real crank geometry. Explode, X-ray and watch the firing order.

projects.title: FoodChart

projects.title: GeoPolitics: the Weave
projects.line: 151 organisations, shared languages and games series drawn as threads through their members' capitals: politics, economics, defence, culture, games and history woven over one map.

projects.title: website-toolkit
projects.line: A kit of 18 copy-paste website parts drawn as a plastic model kit: every part a live miniature on a moulded sprue, re-themed in one click, stripped bare with X-ray, assembled in a sandbox that copies exactly what it shows, and fetched by agents from a hashed JSON registry.

projects.title: AWS Encyclopedia
projects.line: All 436 AWS service APIs on one wall, counted from Amazon's own SDK, the 13 you meet first, and why a website needs only one file on Shadw.

projects.title: Physics Map
projects.line: A living field guide to how physics fits together.

projects.line: ESP32, Arduino and the hardware around them, explained.

projects.title: Divine Transport Group

projects.title: Thomas Sowell: an appreciation

projects.title: Science Encyclopedia

projects.title: Ages of Rule
projects.line: A timeline of 56 governance systems over 5,226 years, drawn as how many were alive in each year, with 166 countries from CountryData one click away.

projects.title: Learn Bash

projects.title: Global Indexes

projects.title: Learn Docker
projects.line: An unofficial guide to Docker, led by the build drawn as layers from real builds: which steps the cache reused and which ran again, with all 34 commands run against a real daemon.

projects.title: SecureTech Solutions
projects.line: A security consultancy whose landing is a year wheel: type a password and see how long one core needs to find it for three ways a site might store it, with the page colour moving from hot pink to lime with the answer.

projects.line: A Next.js whitewater rafting site where one number, the river level, runs everything: the class of every rapid, who may ride, the price, and the colour of the page. Includes a raft you can run down the river and a gate that recomputes every figure.

projects.title: uTCP and MCP

projects.title: Learn CSS
projects.line: A hands-on CSS course where every lesson has a live playground that prints the exact CSS it just wrote: a box model you can drag, a selector tester, flexbox and grid labs, and animations that respect reduced motion.

projects.title: Learn Kubernetes
projects.line: Kubernetes drawn plainly in Kubernetes blue: a landing chart that links every lesson, hand-drawn diagrams of the control plane, objects and Services, and four labs where you kill a pod, flip a label and step through a rolling update.

projects.title: Learn Solidity

projects.title: Learn C and its family

projects.title: Taos River Adventures
